classification: Post-disclosure R26/R27 mechanism study only; not independent, enrollment, default, deployment, hardware or safety evidence.

mechanism.single_proposal: During the already-owned Settled.rising excursion, publish the inherited four-sample notice once when both existing signed 40-sample changes remain positive and both current measured means exceed the frozen pose-conditioned FeasibleNormals.
mechanism.composition: Subclass experiments.r29_disjoint_events.candidate:Detector; call its update exactly once; preserve its linked native event and detached endpoint.
mechanism.same_event: Start the existing ContinuousForceLink with the same Settled axis/reference/peak. Suppress only the later optional plateau pulse for an excursion already announced; never suppress an active native route.

forbidden: true force or label at runtime
future held long or fresh directions for enrollment

gates: all strict C3 and earlier composed events preserved within +5 ms and +5 active samples
one rising notice per physical excursion

followup_only_if_first_passes.rule: No alternate mechanism or source change after first forced result. Report failures without retuning.
